title: Every Dead Pixel Game Was Built on the Same Lake #shorts
desc:
The LAMPLIGHT disc has one map file: MERROW.MAP. Open it in a level viewer and the fog town, the ice fishing hut and the signal box are all on the same lake. And the lighthouse beam is fixed on one building.

Full story on the channel: The PS2 Lighthouse Game That Counts One Boat Too Many (LAMPLIGHT, Dead Pixel Studios).

Fiction. PS2-era low-poly visuals, synthetic narration.
#shorts #analoghorror #ps2 #lostmedia
